```zig
const std = @import("std");
const mem = std.mem;
const fmt = std.fmt;

pub const Pair = struct {
    first: u64,
    second: u64,
};

pub const Palindrome = struct {
    value: u64,
    factors: []Pair,
};

fn isPalindrome(n: u64) bool {
    if n < 10 return true;
    var reversed: u64 = 0;
    var temp = n;
    while (temp > 0) : (temp /= 10) {
        reversed = reversed * 10 + temp % 10;
    }
    return reversed == n;
}

fn integerSqrt(n: u64) u64 {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    var x: u64 = @intCast(@sqrt(@floatFromInt(n)));
    // Adjust for floating point imprecision
    while (x * x > n) : (x -= 1) {}
    while ((x + 1) * (x + 1) <= n) : (x += 1) {}
    return x;
}

pub fn smallest(allocator: mem.Allocator, min: u64, max: u64) mem.Allocator.Error!?Palindrome {
    if (min > max) return null;
    
    // Find the smallest palindrome value
    var best_value: ?u64 = null;
    var i: u64 = min;
    while (i <= max) : (i += 1) {
        if (best_value) |bv| {
            if (i * i > bv) break;
        }
        var j: u64 = i;
        while (j <= max) : (j += 1) {
            const product = i * j;
            if (best_value) |bv| {
                if (product > bv) break;
            }
            if (isPalindrome(product)) {
                if (best_value == null or product < best_value.?) {
                    best_value = product;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    const value = best_value orelse return null;
    
    // Collect all factor pairs
    var factors = std.ArrayList(Pair).init(allocator);
    errdefer factors.deinit();
    
    const sqrt_val = integerSqrt(value);
    var f: u64 = min;
    while (f <= sqrt_val and f <= max) : (f += 1) {
        if (value % f == 0) {
            const other = value / f;
            if (other >= f and other <= max) {
                try factors.append(.{ .first = f, .second = other });
            }
        }
    }
    
    return Palindrome{ .value = value, .factors = try factors.toOwnedSlice(allocator) };
}
